values.goal: Make authorized C-SDLC v2 merges explicit, typed, and effortless without weakening readiness gates.
values.required_outcome: A separate Rust binary validates canonical merge readiness, performs an exact-head GitHub merge, and returns the merge SHA.
authority_boundary: Merge only the bound PR after canonical readiness; never merge arbitrary PRs or replace review/closeout.
operator_constraints: No shell or Python lifecycle path
